arithmeticThisRowDisproves.comment: The exact defect the inventory had to confirm before any meter work.
arithmeticThisRowDisproves.numeratorPlane: summed main-loop input across the turn's API calls (Cretli adds cache read + cache write into inputTokens), NOT context occupancy
arithmeticThisRowDisproves.note: Both ratios are meaningless as context fill. 668113 counts the same cached prefix once per API call, so it grows with turn length, not with window occupancy, and it can exceed any window in the row.

usage.scope: main agent loop only, excludes Task subagents, sidechain and auxiliary calls
usage.granularity: per-turn in streaming-input sessions (Cretli runs one persistent query per room)
usage.measurementKind: cumulative within the turn, per the summed per-call inputs

modelUsage.scope: every model call through the query pipeline, INCLUDING subagents and internal compaction calls
modelUsage.granularity: cumulative for the whole query() call; each result carries the running total, so read the latest result and never sum across results
modelUsage.resumeBehaviour: a resumed or forked session continues from the totals its transcript saved
modelUsage.contextWindowField: per-model denominator only, not paired with any numerator

totalCostUsd.warning: an estimate, not a billing statement; costBasis 'unknown' means the CLI guessed at a default model rate
